Apple Or Cherry Burritos
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 17, 2009 - 11:59pm

Ingredients




1 can apple or cherry pie filling
1 pkg. (12) flour tortillas
Oil for frying
1 tablespoon butter
1 cup powdered sugar
3/4 teaspoon vanilla
2 tablespoons hot water

Preparation

1 Put small amount of pie filling into the center of a tortilla. Fold tortilla like a burrito. Fry quickly in hot oil until brown, turning to brown both sides. Drain on paper towels. Drizzle with glaze.
